card.name: Word starts before a predictable ending
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer word, such as 'st' before 'ench', 'upa' or 'ucco', 'se' before 'eping', or 'hem' before 'operfusion'. It also fires on a few other words such as 'goalkeeper' that are followed by a fixed continuation.

modes.label: Split st- words
modes.description: The 'st' piece begins a word like stench, stupa or stucco after 'the', 'great' or 'intricate'.
modes.example: In the dry season, we are told, the<< st>>ench was intolerable.

modes.label: Split se- and hem- words
modes.description: A short opening piece of a word like seep or hemoperfusion, with the rest of the word coming next.
modes.example: the oil to have<< se>>eped through the rock layers and eventually

modes.label: Other words before a noun
modes.description: A whole word such as 'goalkeeper' or 'with' appears where a name or object follows.
modes.example: Serbian<< goalkeeper>> Dragan Pantelić and, more
